data.title: Speed round: a safe item quantity
story: Write a function safe_qty(qty). If qty is less than 1, return 1. If it is more than 100, return 100. Otherwise, return qty as it is.
There are hidden tests for negative numbers and very large numbers!

explanation: Two ifs guard the lower and upper limits, and everything else is returned as it is. Limiting a range like this (clamping) stops buyers from typing negative or huge quantities.
hints: Start with the lower limit: what is returned when qty < 1?
Add a second if for qty > 100, then return qty at the end.
